body:
The 528Hz Frequency Bracelet is a first-of-its-kind wearable tool—crafted to harness and broadcast the energy of 528Hz, the frequency of transformation, divine love, and DNA repair. This bracelet was designed to help you hold this energy all day long, even when your generator is turned off.

Why 528Hz? Because it’s the frequency of miracles. When you’re vibrating in this range, your energy field becomes magnetic to blessings, opportunities, healing, and abundance. But few people can maintain this frequency consistently—until now.

Benefits of Wearing This Frequency:

  • Accelerates manifestation and attracts aligned opportunities

  • Supports cellular harmony and energetic regeneration

  • Recalibrates your field to the frequency of divine love and expansion

  • Raises your vibration for emotional clarity, peace, and magnetic presence

  • Helps anchor intentions so they can take form faster

The Formula:

  • Green Chrome Diopside – Opens your field to growth, vitality, and soul-aligned action

  • Strawberry Quartz – Anchors the frequency of joy, receptivity, and miracle-mindedness

  • Purple Sandalwood – Creates spiritual grounding and heart-centered awareness

  • Clear Quartz – Amplifies and stores frequency, stabilizing your intentions

  • Abalone Shell – Reflects the energy of flow, balance, and divine feminine radiance

  • Custom 5D Torus Charm – Symbolizes infinite expansion, frequency coherence, and manifestation

Use this bracelet to call in rapid shifts. To step into your highest potential. To stay connected to the energy of miracles, wherever you go.

Pair it with your 528Hz FrequencyGenerator and charge it for 33 minutes before wear to lock in the vibration. Feel the difference. Watch what unfolds.
